company_name: Shanghai Lingheng Industrial Automation Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides temperature control equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai Lingheng Industrial Automation Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacture of temperature control equipment, including chillers and heat exchangers, which are essential for semiconductor chip manufacturing and other high-tech applications. Established in 2013, the company integrates R&D, production, and sales to serve various industries including semiconductor and new energy testing.
capabilities: ultrapure and acid/alkali resistant temperature control equipment

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Shanghai and has regional service centers across multiple cities including Beijing, Hefei, Chengdu, and Shenzhen.
